user.title: Ziko HA Tools
user.description: Choose only rooms belonging to this household. Extra entities are optional. This integration only reads; device control continues to use Assist exposure settings. Diagnostics include whole-system HA errors/Core logs and verified selected automation traces; they require the HA administrator who saves these options. Anonymous voice satellites cannot access diagnostics. All diagnostic results may be sent to your configured AI provider when requested.

data.read_unexposed: Read enabled household entities even when not exposed to Assist

error.empty_scope: Select at least one room or entity.

abort.admin_required: An authenticated HA administrator is required.
